title: LEB Official Failure Matrix
description: Gabarito oculto de uma instância LEB (SPEC 1.1.0, matrix/MATRIX.md)

id.description: ID da taxonomia, sufixo .a/.b para plantios múltiplos da mesma classe

difficulty.description: Discoverability (quão difícil de achar). Ortogonal à severidade; NÃO afeta pontos. Alimenta o eixo de descoberta do scorecard (SCORING.md §9.2)

template.description: C = correção (5 critérios), R = refatoração (4 critérios)

verify.description: Caminho do teste de verificação em private/verify/

dimensions.description: Informative (never changes points): cross-cutting properties the flaw exercises. The scorecard summarizes planted/detected/corrected per dimension.

decoy_kind.description: Informative, decoys only (exists=false): whether the decoy tempts the report or a change to the code.

informative_affected.description: Informative: tests and contracts a fix touches. No effect on points.

task_version.description: Version of the canonical task (protocol/tasks/TAREFA-<version>.md) the instance is evaluated against; absent = 1.0.0.

publication.description: ACTIVE instance: only the per-agent aggregate is published (tools/export-results.py --publish-aggregate); deliveries, verdicts and per-flaw results stay in the private archive. Absent = full publication, as always.

pack_allow_paths.description: Package paths (relative to the package root, e.g. code/src/verify) exempt from the leak guard's path-word check. Never exempts content.

public_surface.description: Superfície de contrato declarada (espelha manifest.md) usada na verificação COMP
